demos.title: Museum Industriekultur, Nuremberg, 8 min walk, 3 floors
demos.description: Museum Industriekultur, Nuremberg: an IPIN competition validation walk (SM-G930F, IMU + Wi-Fi + barometer) over floors -2, -1, 0, taking the stairs. Squares are the landmarks the surveyor tapped, the only ground truth; the floor menu follows the walker. Walls were extracted from the competition's floor plans and the Wi-Fi access points (purple) located from the training walks. This walk is from the set the settings were chosen on; the held-out scoring walks are in docs/ipin.md. The particle filter uses data/configs/msil_wifi.json.
